profile.headline: Senior Systems Software Engineer in AR/VR/audio/graphics devices, game development, focused on agentic AI architectures and machine learning.
profile.summary: An accomplished Senior Systems Engineer with over thirty years of software development experience. Specializes in bridging the gap between low-level hardware diagnostics, system-level debugging, and advanced machine learning implementations. Proven track record of developing autonomous testing frameworks and deploying ML models for anomaly detection and hardware performance validation. Currently focused on developing agentic AI architectures to automate complex diagnostic, execution, and analysis workflows.

positions.title: Staff Systems Software Engineer
positions.description: Development work at Magic Leap centers on the creation of a 3d augmented reality platform for use in enterprise, education, health, and military applications. The platform allows for the real time display of virtual content and information into real world environments.I work on the Systems Analysis Verification and Validation team which develops applications that test and validate the 3d AR experience. I develop C++ and Unity C# apps that test Magic Leap hardware features such as hand tracking, eye tracking, head position, and spatial mapping. I also develop applications in Unity 3d that support our automated robotic testing framework that allows us to stress test various subsystems and collect key indicators over time so that we can evaluate the performance of the system as new software releases are made. I also develop Unity 3d prototype apps that demonstrate the various features of the Magic Leap Unity SDK. Magic Leap is also in partnership with Google and are developing AR devices on the Google Android XR operating system. My part in this is developing Unity apps that analyse hand, eye, and gesture tracking sensor data to determine Android XR hardware performance for the Samsung Galaxy XR. I am also doing development work on creating machine learning models that do gesture recognition to enable users to interact with interfaces projected on to surfaces. (Skills: Unity, C#, C++, python)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Development centers on an analytics product called Dell Insights, which helps enterprise companies manage vast numbers of systems. It collects data such as performance counters, I/O usage, resource monitoring, and sends it to the cloud where data analysis and machine learning are applied to detect potential hardware issues or security risks. I worked on the development of C# and C++ software plugin framework that collects performance metrics and data on systems and sends it to the cloud. I also did development on a python testing environment to automate and validate the testing of these data collection services. (Skills: C#, C++, python)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Founder)
positions.description: Computational Arts is devoted to developing applications that utilize cutting edge software tools and frameworks to create audio/visual applications, installations, and content development tools. As lead software developer, I spear head development of audio/visual applications (Win, macOS), interactive media performances (Max/MSP/Jitter), game development (Xbox, PlayStation, PC, Unity), embedded microcontroller systems integration (Arduino, Linux), and app development (iOS, Win, macOS). Accomplishments: Spotify Music Trivia Game (SXSW showcase) done with C# Unity game engine and Javascript server. Max/C++ video installation created for the Concordia University of Montreal, Faculty of Fine Art that generated real time narratives with video streams stored on servers, controlled with motion sensors.  (Skills: Max, C++, C#, Unity)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Software endeavors focused on python, C++, and C#  development of computer vision and machine learning applications for robotics and industrial automation. Supported development of visual inspection system that used openCV, C++, and C# to apply computer vision algorithms to extract details about objects. This visual data was applied to a machine learning model to detect anomalies. Visual data was then stored in a SQL server data base so that anomalous objects could be reviewed at a later time.  (Skills: python, C++, C#, machine learning)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Development focused on developing software services and applications that provided video analytics for enterprise video teleconferencing networks (Cisco and Polycom). Design and implementation of WPF client applications in (C#) .Net that provide an interface for video recording and publishing, call routing, and conference control, and video analytics. I then ported this application to the iOS platform and managed both product lines. I then developed windows data services (C#) that monitored video hardware and gathered metrics on video streams. These metrics are stored in an SQL database and then displayed in an analytics portal that gives users real-time information on the utilization and status of the video network. Worked on developing data analysis tools in python (numpy, pandas, seaborn) to detect data usage trends and anomalies. ( Skills : C#, Objective-C, iOS, SQL, python)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
The work done at Aspyr was software development for video game titles on the PC. Programming tasks were quite varied and encompassed networking, audio, graphics, and tools development.  
(Skills Utilized: C++, C, C#, SQL, DirectX)
Projects and  Accomplishments: 
• Tony Hawk’s American Wasteland (PC), developed C++ language localization apps using an SQL database. 
• Sims Life Stories (PC), Sims Pets Stories (PC), Sims Castaway (PC): all required enhancements to existing code bases. Enhanced a C++ scripting editor that allowed adding of new assets and interactions in game.  
• Implemented a C++/C# language localization application for the Sims titles. Allowed users to import text in to an SQL database, created exports of data for translations, and updated game assets with localized text.
• For Turok (PC), contributed to the porting of the Xbox code base to the Unreal Engine and integrated a C++ Voice over IP API in to the game. I also managed language localization for this title. 
• For Guitar Hero4 (PC), re-implemented the networking API to support match making and network play.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Overwatch is a defense contractor that does software development for the military and intelligence agencies. Much of the work done was C# .Net application development. Many tasks dealt with developing new database technologies and integrating them into legacy systems. (Skills Utilized: C++, C, C#, SQL.)
Projects and  Accomplishments:
•	Developed several data transformers in C# that translated military map data into various other formats. 
•	Implemented a C# application that automated the subscription to, and handling of, different intelligence command and control server sources into one SQL database.
•	Integrated new C++ database APIs into legacy systems. One such system, was the Advanced Field Artillery Tactical Data System (AFATDS). After integration, this system was able to interface with newer databases to receive targeting data.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contract position doing work on Win XP audio driver development for Sigmatel’s AC97 audio codec. This codec was integrated into various chipset designs by laptop vendors. (Skills Utilized: C++, COM, drivers, Visual Basic)
Projects and  Accomplishments:
•	Ported a kernel mode MIDI software synthesizer to work with the SigmaTel audio codec
•	Developed a C++ kernel mode DSP plug-in architecture that allowed third party vendors the ability to add their DSP technology to Sigmatel’s WDM audio stack
•	Implemented a Visual Basic control panel application that used a COM interface to configure driver settings and detect the insertion of jacks into audio ports.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Embedded software development for mobile devices in a WinCE/ARM environment. Much of this work entailed software support of a hardware Java byte code accelerator (Skills Utilized: C++, C, JAVA, ARM, drivers)
Projects and Accomplishments: Ported WinCE to an ARM simulator (Armulator)
Developed a WinCE board support package enabling us to run WinCE on ARM based development hardware Utilized a combination of C, C++, and ARM (assembler ) to integrate a JAVA byte code hardware accelerator in to a Java (Sun) virtual machine. Implemented a C++ WinCE device driver that did address translation from virtual memory to physical memory.  This enabled execution of instructions that were generated by the JAVA accelerator. Implemented different JAVA applets that tested the performance of the hardware accelerated virtual machine.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
The work done at 3dfx was 3d graphics driver development. This entailed enhancing C++ interfaces to support new hardware features as well expose new functionality to the operating system and users. (Skills Utilized: C++, C, drivers, DirectX)
Projects and Accomplishments: Implemented C++ software support of Direct3D (DirectX 7) features. C++ development support for the Rampage (Voodoo6) graphics driver WDM video capture drivers for the VoodooTV line of products (Win98, Win2000) Managed hardware components (audio decoder, video decoder, TV tuner) and exposed their functionality by implementing various DirectShow C++ filters. This allowed capture of audio and video from an analog signal

positions.title: Software Engineer IV
positions.description:
The work done at Cirrus was windows audio device driver development support for the Cirrus AC97 and the CS4281 audio codec. This hardware codec was integrated in to laptop designs. (Skills Utilized: C++, C, COM, drivers)
Projects and Accomplishments: Implemented C++ driver classes that allowed the AC97 hardware to access the Intel 810 I/O controller hub. Implemented WDM device driver classes that exposed the hardware functionality of the Crystal CS4281 to the operating system. Designed a C++ control panel application that allowed users to set hardware settings and frequency equalization on the CS4281. Worked directly with OEMs to integrate these chips in to various laptop chipset designs

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
The work done at Adaptec was IEEE 1394 (Firewire) software development for the PC. Much of the development centered on implementing a software stack that allowed hard disk capture of audio/video streams from DV Firewire cameras. (Skills Utilized: C++, C, MMX, driver, DirectX)
Projects and  Accomplishments: 
Developed a suite of test harness applications written in C++ that tested the low level driver protocol for the Skipstone 1394 device adapter. Managed a C++ audio compression manager (ACM) that used the Adaptec 1394 hardware API to capture video frames and decode audio from them. Contributed to the enhancement of a DV image codec. Along with bug fixes, work was done in optimizing portions of this codec to utilize MMX SIMD instructions to do color space conversion. Implemented a C++ Image Compression Manager (ICM) that exposed this DV codec to the operating system. Developed a C++ Video For Windows capture driver that utilized the ACM and the ICM to allow software applications like Adobe Premiere to capture video. Developed a video capture application called DVdeck and added functionality to this application that used a 1394 camera control protocol to seek and capture a user specified list of time code positions.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Acclaim/Iguana Entertainment 

The work done at Iguana Entertainment dealt with graphics and audio programming on different hardware platforms such as the Sony Playstation and the Nintendo 64. (Skills Utilized: C++, C)
Projects and  Accomplishments: 
Designed and implemented a Playstation hardware abstraction layer for the title Quarterback Club 97 (PSX). Implemented the entire fronted user interface system (in C) for Quarterback Club Developed a UI component library that supported 3d projections, rotations, translation, and texture mapping of polygons on the Playstation. Engineered an in game animation compression playback engine that displayed pre-rendered frames of sprites. For Frank Thomas Big Hurt Baseball (PSX), designed a real-time audio streaming library (in C ). Turok Dinosaur Hunter (N64), developed a 3d audio engine that consisted of two parts: an in game audio engine that placed objects in 3d sound space and an editor (C++) that provided an interface that sound designers could use to build composite sounds from smaller sound assets

Acclaim/Iguana Entertainment 

The work done at Iguana Entertainment dealt with graphics and audio programming on different hardware platforms such as the Sony Playstation and the Nintendo 64. (Skills Utilized: C++, C)
Projects and  Accomplishments: 
Designed and implemented a Playstation hardware abstraction layer for the title Quarterback Club 97 (PSX). Implemented the entire fronted user interface system (in C) for Quarterback Club Developed a UI component library that supported 3d projections, rotations, translation, and texture mapping of polygons on the Playstation. Engineered an in game animation compression playback engine that displayed pre-rendered frames of sprites. For Frank Thomas Big Hurt Baseball (PSX), designed a real-time audio streaming library (in C ). Turok Dinosaur Hunter (N64), developed a 3d audio engine that consisted of two parts: an in game audio engine that placed objects in 3d sound space and an editor (C++) that provided an interface that sound designers could use to build composite sounds from smaller sound assets
